# Check the keyboard header-menu path as well as the mouse contextmenu path

HeaderMessageId makes the span focusable and forwards contextmenu to openMessageIdPopup. The !event.screenX branch opens the popup and returns before sending on-build-contextmenu to extensions. This coordinate check can also cover a mouse event at screenX zero; it does not identify keyboard input by event type. The new/current test uses mouse contextmenu helpers. Recommend keyboard-triggered and zero-coordinate tests for extension item presence and data. This is a static branch-coverage concern, not a reproduced failure. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: message header menu accessibility.
